AnalyticalPeriodConfig.description:
Time axis definition for analysis.

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for time-related calculations.
All modules must use this instead of hardcoded 8760/365 or date(year, 1, 1).

The time axis is defined by:
- start_datetime: When the analysis period begins
- interval_minutes: Data resolution (15 or 60)
- n_points: Number of data points (determines period length)

The end_datetime is calculated as: start + (n_points - 1) * interval

Usage:
- ToU pricing: Use time_index derived from this for zone lookup
- Capacity fee: Use time_index for working day determination
- Daily metrics: Use groupby(date) on time_index, NOT hardcoded 365 days

clock_mode.description: Clock mode: CET_FIXED (ignore DST) or LOCAL_TZ (honor DST)
clock_mode.title: Clock Mode

n_points.description: Number of data points (determines period length)
n_points.title: N Points

timestamps.description: If provided, use these timestamps 1:1 instead of generating from start_datetime
timestamps.title: Timestamps

AnalyticalPeriodConfig.title: AnalyticalPeriodConfig

ArbitrageConfig.description:
Configuration for Time-of-Use (ToU) arbitrage dispatch.

Arbitrage exploits price differences between tariff zones:
- Charge from grid when price is low (below threshold)
- Discharge when price is high (above threshold)

IMPORTANT: For NPV calculations, capacity fee (opłata mocowa) is NOT
included in price thresholds. It's calculated post-dispatch using
the capacity_fee_pl module based on the actual import profile.

Integration with STACKED mode:
- Peak shaving has priority 1 (can use full SOC range)
- PV surplus charging has priority 2 (always before grid charging)
- Arbitrage grid-charge has priority 3 (only if spare charging capacity)
- Arbitrage discharge has priority 4 (when price high and SOC > floor)

allow_grid_charging.description: Allow charging battery from grid for arbitrage. If False, only PV surplus can charge battery.
allow_grid_charging.title: Allow Grid Charging

capacity_fee_pln_kwh.description: Capacity fee in steering prices [PLN/kWh]. Keep 0 for accurate NPV.
capacity_fee_pln_kwh.title: Capacity Fee Pln Kwh

charge_below_percentile.description: Charge from grid when price below this percentile [%]
charge_below_percentile.title: Charge Below Percentile

discharge_above_percentile.description: Discharge when price above this percentile [%]
discharge_above_percentile.title: Discharge Above Percentile

max_cycles_per_day.description: Maximum EFC cycles per day for arbitrage. None = no limit.
max_cycles_per_day.title: Max Cycles Per Day

max_grid_charge_kw.description: Maximum power for grid charging [kW]. None = use battery power.
max_grid_charge_kw.title: Max Grid Charge Kw

max_throughput_mwh_per_day.description: Maximum throughput per day [MWh]. None = no limit.
max_throughput_mwh_per_day.title: Max Throughput Mwh Per Day

DegradationBudget.description:
Degradation budget constraints for battery lifecycle management.

Supports both annual and daily limits to control battery wear.
Daily limits are enforced in real-time during dispatch.
Annual limits are checked post-dispatch for reporting.

max_cycles_per_day.description: Max EFC cycles per day. Enforced in real-time during dispatch.
max_cycles_per_day.title: Max Cycles Per Day

max_efc_per_year.description: Max equivalent full cycles per year
max_efc_per_year.title: Max Efc Per Year

max_throughput_mwh_per_day.description: Max throughput per day [MWh]. Enforced in real-time during dispatch.
max_throughput_mwh_per_day.title: Max Throughput Mwh Per Day

DegradationBudget.title: DegradationBudget

GridConstraints.description:
Grid connection constraints (v0.7.0).

Defines physical limits of the grid connection that apply to both
baseline and project scenarios. These are hard limits that cannot
be exceeded regardless of battery operation.

allow_export.description: Whether grid export is allowed. If False, all excess PV is curtailed or stored in battery. Equivalent to max_export_kw=0.
allow_export.title: Allow Export

max_export_kw.description: Maximum grid export power [kW]. If set, excess PV is curtailed. None = no limit (unconstrained export).
max_export_kw.title: Max Export Kw

max_import_kw.description: Maximum grid import power [kW]. If set, load exceeding this + PV + battery results in unserved load. None = no limit (unconstrained import).
max_import_kw.title: Max Import Kw

unserved_load_penalty_pln_kwh.description: Penalty cost per kWh of unserved load [PLN/kWh]. Used for economic impact calculation when import cap causes unserved load.
unserved_load_penalty_pln_kwh.title: Unserved Load Penalty Pln Kwh

GridConstraints.title: GridConstraints

PriceConfig.description:
Energy price configuration.

Supports two pricing modes:
1. Flat pricing (legacy): Single import/export rate
2. ToU pricing (Opcja B): OSD tariff + OTHER fees + capacity fee separately

When tariff_id is set, ToU pricing is used with:
- OSD rates = energia czynna + dystrybucja (combined from preset)
- other_fees = OZE + kog + jakość + akcyza (added on top)
- capacity_fee = calculated separately via capacity_fee_pl module

capacity_fee_fixed_pln_mwh.description: Fixed capacity fee rate [PLN/MWh] - only for 'fixed' method
capacity_fee_fixed_pln_mwh.title: Capacity Fee Fixed Pln Mwh

capacity_fee_som_pln_kwh.description: SOM rate for dynamic capacity fee [PLN/kWh]
capacity_fee_som_pln_kwh.title: Capacity Fee Som Pln Kwh

demand_charge_pln_kw_month.description: Monthly demand charge [PLN/kW/month] based on peak import
demand_charge_pln_kw_month.title: Demand Charge Pln Kw Month

demand_charge_pln_kw_year.description: Annual demand charge [PLN/kW/year] based on peak import
demand_charge_pln_kw_year.title: Demand Charge Pln Kw Year

tariff_id.description: OSD tariff preset ID. If set, uses ToU pricing instead of flat.
tariff_id.title: Tariff Id

PriceConfig.title: PriceConfig

ProfileUnit.description:
Units for input power profiles.

All profiles should be in kW_avg (average power over interval).
This enum enables explicit declaration and validation.
ProfileUnit.title: ProfileUnit

allow_reserve_breach.description: Allow using reserve in emergency (with warning)
allow_reserve_breach.title: Allow Reserve Breach

reserve_fraction.description: SOC fraction reserved for peak shaving [0-1]
reserve_fraction.title: Reserve Fraction

TopologyType.description:
System topology - defines which components are present.

Used to validate input profiles and select appropriate algorithms.
TopologyType.title: TopologyType

analytical_period.description: Time axis configuration. If provided, is the single source of truth for time calculations.

arbitrage_config.description: ToU arbitrage configuration. If enabled, adds arbitrage to STACKED mode.

grid_constraints.description: Grid connection constraints (max_export_kw, max_import_kw, allow_export). Applied to both baseline and project scenarios.

include_battery_trace.description: Include per-timestep battery trace in response. Shows soc_kwh, charge_kw, discharge_kw at each timestep for dispatch debugging.

include_economics_timeseries.title: Include Economics Timeseries

include_energy_flows_timeseries.description: Include per-timestep energy flows in response. False = only totals_mwh (small). True = also timeseries_kwh (large).
include_energy_flows_timeseries.title: Include Energy Flows Timeseries

profile_unit.description: Unit of input profiles (must be kW_avg for dispatch)

pv_generation_kw.description: PV generation [kW_avg]. Can be empty for LOAD_ONLY topology.
pv_generation_kw.title: Pv Generation Kw

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for tariff price lookup. Required if arbitrage enabled.
start_date.title: Start Date
